subject: Post-call: FinPay stakeholder map & MAP draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@finpay.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: FinPay stakeholder map & MAP draft

Thanks Alex and Priya 

- great call today. Quick recap and next steps so we all have alignment.

Call summary (30 min):
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency inference across FinPay web & mobile flows (high volume, PII proximal).
- Decision criteria: latency under 120ms p50 for core flows, SOC 2 evidence & data residency controls, predictable monthly committed capacity, clear unit economics.
- Economic buyer: Priya Sharma (CFO) 

- cost/ROI questions.
- Technical/architecture: Alex and engineering (integration) team.
- Security/legal/procurement: procurement@finpay.com + legal (TBD).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) 

- attached: Redwood_MAP_FinPay_v1.xlsx
Milestones I propose:
1) Security questionnaire & SOC 2 mapping 

- week of Feb 22 (owner: FinPay legal + Redwood security).
2) Technical POC ingest + perf run (3 days) 

- week of Mar 1 (owner: FinPay eng + Redwood infra).
3) Commercial review & redlines 

- week of Mar 8 (owner: Priya + Redwood Sales).
4) Procurement sign-off & contract 

- target by Mar 15.

Ask: Can you confirm the legal/procurement contacts and whether the March 15 target is realistic from your side? I can update the MAP and send a version with assigned owners and dates once you confirm.

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_FinPay_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks 

- looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@finpay.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, procurement@finpay.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinPay stakeholder map & MAP draft

Thanks Marissa 

- good summary. A couple of updates from our side:
- Legal contact: David Lee (david.lee@finpay.com) 

- I'll loop him into the security questionnaire thread.
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com is correct; their formal timing will depend on contract redlines, but they're aware of our timeline.
- Economics: Priya will want a simple cost/benefit table comparing Redwood-hosted vs. self-hosted baseline.

Tentative timelines look fine. Security kickoff week of Feb 22 works for us.

I'll ask David and procurement to review the MAP and confirm owners by end of day Friday.

- Alex
Director of Engineering, FinPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@finpay.com>, David Lee <david.lee@finpay.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, procurement@finpay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinPay stakeholder map & MAP draft

Thanks Alex 

- looping David, welcome.

I've updated the MAP with the owners and a proposed timeline (see attached MAP-FinPay-v1.1.xlsx). Key changes:
- Added David Lee (Legal) and procurement@finpay.com to the security/legal milestone.
- Added Rishi as Redwood security owner for the SOC 2 evidence collection.
- Added a pricing summary page for Priya with projected monthly committed cost vs. estimated token usage.

Next actions for this week:
- David/legal: share any compliance checklist items or questionnaire you prefer we start with.
- Procurement: confirm contract terms/process and whether PoPs (proofs of performance) are required before PoC billing.
- Alex/engineering: confirm POC window (we had proposed Mar 1-3).

Attachment: MAP-FinPay-v1.1.xlsx (updated MAP)

If everyone is OK, I'll schedule a 45-min security kickoff with Rishi and your legal lead for Feb 23 at 10am PT. Please confirm or suggest alternatives.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Camila
